title: Downtown LA in French: Historic District and Little Tokyo
includes: Photos of you, for memories that last
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Downtown LA through a 3h30 walking tour that reveals its fascinating history and architectural treasures. Walk through the historic district, admire iconic buildings such as the cinemas or Walt Disney Concert Hall and dive into the cosmopolitan atmosphere of Little Tokyo. A Francophone Guide will share captivating anecdotes and give you a unique cultural immersion in the heart of the California metropolis. In a small group of up to 10 people, this experience promises a new look at the City of Angels.

 - 3h30 Walking Tour in Downtown LA and Little Tokyo
 - Francophone Guide offering local stories and anecdotes
 - Small group (maximum 10 people)
 - Wheelchair accessible with adapted circuits
